numerical_profile: 1 worker, one BLAS thread; 120 cumulative CPU-minute ceiling; no adaptive sample extension
inference: 32 accessible reset triplets per target world; finite difference .002; one constrained fit of two coefficients. Per-world adaptation, not zero-shot numerical-constant transfer.
primary: paired world mean F2 minus comparator MSE at horizon16; comparator selected from development at same horizon; all baselines retained
inference_statistics: 4000 paired world bootstrap draws, stratified by id modulo4; 98.333333 percentile intervals for 3 families; approximate Bonferroni descriptive intervals, not exact guarantees
margin_units: fixed nondimensional squared position; engineering threshold, not physical significance
uncertainty: per-family world maximum absolute residual across replicates,origins,horizons; 80% order-statistic rank11 of12 calibration worlds; shifted final coverage descriptive
divergence: nonfinite or |prediction|>1e6; loss cap1e12; retain count and uncapped finite errors
